svg.data-power-input: 100 - 240 V AC, 47 - 63 Hz, two inputs, two hot-swap supplies; nominal current 10.25 A, maximum current 12.5 A; 150 W maximum (220 W with both supplies)
svg.data-power-rating-label: 100-240 V ~2,5 A MAX, 50/60Hz (printed between the supplies and the fans)
svg.data-optics-sfp28: brochure: four 25 Gigabit SFP28 ports supporting 1G, 2.5G, 10G and 25G, depending on the module
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: brochure: sixteen 100 Gigabit QSFP28 ports supporting 4x 1G, 4x 2.5G, 4x 10G, 4x 25G, 1x 40G, 2x 50G and 1x 100G, depending on the module; no module is included

g.data-description: the two AC inlets of the two supplies, POWER 1 and POWER 2
